sizes.title: Agents alive, world by world
sizes.caption: Each line is one world, its agents after each game (means over 100 iterations), from its birth in Experiment 17 to iteration 50,000 or to the game after which 20 agents or fewer were left, where the lab stops a world.
sizes.recipe:
**Runs.** The five runs of Experiment 18 — Experiment 17's worlds of seeds 2, 4, 5, 6 and 10 (B2 at 10,000 tokens with brains mixed at birth), played on by the lab from iteration 10,000 to 50,000 or until they died out (`python3 gol_lab.py run E18`); their first 10,000 iterations are Experiment 17's.

**Data.** From Each run's `stats.jsonl`.

1. Read the agents after each game (`nodes`, phase 2).
2. Average over stretches of 100 iterations.

**To make it again:** `python3 book_figures.py longmixed`.

health.title: Health and riches, every 500 iterations
health.caption: Each world read as [Healthy and rich](healthy-and-rich.md) reads every world, from the whole worlds the lab kept every 500 iterations from 10,500 on, while it lived. Left: how many of the seven marks of [How to tell a world that keeps evolving](how-to-tell-a-world-that-keeps-evolving.md)'s health bar it meets (the dots of each world are set a little apart so that they do not hide each other). Right: the share of its agents holding three tokens or fewer.
health.recipe:
**Runs.** The five runs of Experiment 18 — Experiment 17's worlds of seeds 2, 4, 5, 6 and 10 (B2 at 10,000 tokens with brains mixed at birth), played on by the lab from iteration 10,000 to 50,000 or until they died out (`python3 gol_lab.py run E18`); their first 10,000 iterations are Experiment 17's.

**Data.** From Each run's `archive/world_<iteration>.npz` (`research/oee/checks/e17_health.py --seeds 2,4,5,6,10 --from 10500 --to 50000`).

1. Read each whole world as `research/atlas/profile.py` reads every world.
2. Count the marks it meets and its agents at three tokens or fewer.

**To make it again:** `python3 book_figures.py longmixed`.

collapse.title: The worlds that died out
collapse.caption: Each line is a world that died out, read every 500 iterations up to its end: left, the share of its agents that could have a child (11 tokens or more and fewer than 8 links); right, how often they had one in the next 50 iterations, per hundred of them. Every agent dies at 100, so a world whose agents all could have a child dies out once they have fewer than one per hundred an iteration.
collapse.recipe:
**Runs.** The five runs of Experiment 18 — Experiment 17's worlds of seeds 2, 4, 5, 6 and 10 (B2 at 10,000 tokens with brains mixed at birth), played on by the lab from iteration 10,000 to 50,000 or until they died out (`python3 gol_lab.py run E18`); their first 10,000 iterations are Experiment 17's.

**Data.** From Each run's whole worlds and births (`research/oee/checks/e17_breeding.py --seeds 2,4,10 --from 10000 --to 50000`).

1. In each whole world, count the agents with 11 tokens or more and fewer than 8 links.
2. Divide the births per iteration of the next 50 iterations by them.

**To make it again:** `python3 book_figures.py longmixed`.

contests.title: Later brains against earlier ones
contests.caption: Each dot is a contest between two of a world's moments: the brains of the later moment against those of the earlier, half and half on the same world, for 100 iterations, in each moment's world with two seeds; the bar is the median of the four. Above: the pairs the plan named, for the worlds alive then. Below: the brains of the last world kept before each collapse that still had a few hundred agents, against those of 5,000 iterations before.
contests.recipe:
**Runs.** The five runs of Experiment 18 — Experiment 17's worlds of seeds 2, 4, 5, 6 and 10 (B2 at 10,000 tokens with brains mixed at birth), played on by the lab from iteration 10,000 to 50,000 or until they died out (`python3 gol_lab.py run E18`); their first 10,000 iterations are Experiment 17's.

**Data.** From `GraphOfLifeRuns/.pilots/e18_T100.json` (`research/oee/checks/rejudge.py --seeds 17,18`).

1. Seat the brains of the two moments on alternate agents of each moment's world and play 100 iterations, an agent's lifetime.
2. Count the agents the later moment's brains hold at the end, as a share of all.

**To make it again:** `python3 book_figures.py longmixed`.
